Business Administration, MBA

Availability: Online and On-Campus
Degree: MBA

Program Overview

Online MBA Programs at Asbury

Prepare for your future with Asbury University’s online MBA degree. Asbury’s Master of Business Administration program offers three concentrations in Management, Nonprofit Management, and Sport Management.

You will shape the world of tomorrow by engaging in Asbury’s Christ-centered MBA programs, where you will find a compassionate, and supportive environment to explore imaginative solutions. With specialized tracks in career-focused areas, you will gain the skills and knowledge to step into leadership roles and excel across diverse industries.

With a personalized approach to learning, our MBA focuses on fostering critical thinking, innovation, and ethical decision-making. Graduate ready to make a meaningful impact in the global marketplace and navigate the complexities of today’s business world.

Your MBA Career

Students in the MBA program will become well-grounded in the discipline of business management. Recent graduates enter various corporate, nonprofit roles, and sports management, including:

• Administration and Operations

• Leadership and Entrepreneurship

• Communications and Management

MBA Degree Format and Length

Complete Asbury’s MBA degree in as few as 18 months. With 100% online classes held in eight-week blocks and with selected in-seat courses* at our campus in beautiful Wilmore, Kentucky, the flexible format accommodates the needs of working professionals seeking career advancement and offers freedom for students of all professional levels and responsibilities.

*On-campus option for F1 Visa students. Contact Graduate Admissions for more information.

Online MBA Concentrations

Develop your management skills and enhance your understanding of business strategy, finance and marketing. The MBA in Management Concentration prepares you for leadership roles in diverse industries, enabling you to make a meaningful impact in the global marketplace.

Deepen your expertise in the rapidly growing field of sport management, including marketing, event planning and facility management, and discover how you can use your skills to uplift and inspire others. The MBA: Sport Management Concentration prepares you for leadership positions in the sports industry, from professional leagues to community-based programs.

Refine your ability to lead and manage nonprofit organizations with a focus on strategy, fundraising and financial management. The MBA: Nonprofit Management Concentration equips you with the knowledge and skills to drive mission-driven organizations toward success.

Online MBA Degree Requirements

Asbury’s MBA programs require a total of 36 credit hours. You’ll take a balance of core business courses, pathway-specific courses and electives tailored to your interests. Gain sophisticated business development skills and a distinctive sense of how to manage wealth creation in various industries and circumstances.

  • 15 credits in core Dayton School of Business MBA courses
  • 21 credits in courses in your selected concentration (Management, Sports Management, and Nonprofit Management)

Asbury University’s online MBA program educates men and women from around the world in a graduate management curriculum that will enable them to integrate their faith and work in a manner that leads to our distinctive focus on management of the triple bottom line.

Review Complete MBA Degree Requirements

Why an MBA from Asbury?

Our students learn to use business as a vehicle to address economic, social and spiritual poverty. 

Our program embeds prudential and Biblical principles into inquiry across the traditional fields of MBA study, an entrepreneurial theme across all courses and the capstone project, and a focus on business as mission.

Our MBA graduates are poised to provide effective leadership in management, with integrity and conscience, across a broad range of careers and organizations.

Imagine your Asbury Dayton School of Business Success Story

Asbury Graduate Outcomes

Asbury’s MBA graduates are equipped to excel in leadership roles, applying their skills and knowledge to diverse industries. Whether pursuing positions in management or career advancement in their organization, graduates will be prepared to navigate the complexities of the global marketplace.

Here are a few places where our Dayton School of Business undergraduates and MBA/MSA graduates have landed jobs:

  • Microsoft
  • General Electric
  • Lexington Clinic
  • Ernst & Young
  • PNC Bank
  • Tempur-Sealy International
  • Signant Health
  • Cincinnati Reds
  • Cincinnati Bengals
  • Lexington Legends
  • The Salvation Army
  • First Southern National Bank
+Grad for Undergraduate Business Students

The Asbury +Grad Program is designed to give Asbury undergraduate students from all areas of study the opportunity to obtain advanced MBA standing.

As an undergraduate student, you can complete up to 9 credit hours of your graduate degree through the +Grad program. This means that upon graduation from Asbury with your undergrad degree, you can complete a master’s degree in as few as twelve additional months, depending on the program.

Learn more about the +GRAD Program
